articles.title: Create your free account
articles.summary: Make an account and your menu address in two minutes.
articles.body:
You can make a menu for free. You don't need a card.

1. Open **http://127.0.0.1:8000/auth/sign-up**.
2. Type your **Restaurant name**.
3. Choose your **Menu address**. Your menu will be at http://127.0.0.1:8000/your-address. Use small letters, numbers and hyphens.
4. Type your name, your e-mail and a password. Use at least 10 characters.
5. Choose your **Currency**. Your prices are shown in it.
6. Tick the box for the Terms and the Privacy Policy.
7. Tap **Create free account**.
8. Open the e-mail we send you and tap the link. The link works for 24 hours.

![The sign-up page](/help/shots/signup-phone.webp "phone") ![The sign-up page](/help/shots/signup-desktop.webp "desktop")

You start on the **Free** plan. See [what each plan includes](help:plans-compared).

**No e-mail?** Look in your spam folder. On the "Check your inbox" page you can tap **Resend email** or **Change it** if you typed the wrong address.

**"Your account is waiting for approval"?** Sometimes our team checks new restaurants first. You can set up your menu now. Guests can see it once it is approved.

articles.title: Sign in for the first time
articles.summary: Where to sign in, and what you see first.
articles.body:
1. Open **http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin** on your phone or computer.
2. Type your e-mail and password. Tap **Sign in**.
3. If you turned on two-factor sign-in, type the 6-digit code from your phone.

You now see your **Dashboard**. It shows today's menu views and QR scans, and a list called **Finish setting up**.

![The dashboard after the first sign-in](/help/shots/dashboard-phone.webp "phone") ![The dashboard after the first sign-in](/help/shots/dashboard-desktop.webp "desktop")

A short tour shows you the most important places. Tap **Next**, or **Skip tour**. You can open it again from **Help → Take the tour**.

![The welcome tour](/help/shots/tour-phone.webp "phone") ![The welcome tour](/help/shots/tour-desktop.webp "desktop")

Were you invited by someone? Open the invitation e-mail and tap the link. Make a password. Then sign in like above.

articles.title: The setup steps
articles.summary: The "Finish setting up" list makes your menu ready for guests.
articles.body:
The **Finish setting up** list on your dashboard shows what is still missing. Each step opens the right page.

1. **Add your logo.** Go to **Appearance → Logo**. See [Logo and banner](help:logo-and-banner).
2. **Add a banner photo.** The wide photo at the top of your menu.
3. **Add at least 5 dishes.** See [Add a dish](help:add-a-dish).
4. **Add dish photos.** Dishes with photos get opened more.
5. **Set opening hours.** Go to **Restaurant info → Opening hours**.
6. **Add address and contact.** Also on **Restaurant info**.
7. **Download your QR codes.** See [QR codes](help:qr-codes).

When all steps are done, the list says 100 %. Tap **Hide this list** to remove it.

articles.title: Your dashboard
articles.summary: What the cards on the dashboard mean.
articles.body:
The dashboard shows **today** at your restaurant.

- **Menu views today**: how many times your menu was opened. Under it: yesterday's number.
- **QR scans today**: views that came from one of your QR codes.
- **Sold out now**: dishes guests see as sold out. Tap **Available again** when they are back.
- **Views and scans**: a small chart of the last 7 days. Tap **Insights** for more.
- **Dishes without a photo**: the most viewed dishes without a photo come first.
- **"My order" lists**: how many lists guests made on their phones. See [My order](help:my-order).
- **Plan and usage**: your plan, the days left and how much you use.

![The dashboard on a phone and a computer](/help/shots/dashboard-phone.webp "phone") ![The dashboard on a phone and a computer](/help/shots/dashboard-desktop.webp "desktop")

The numbers update within a minute. Search engines and link previews are not counted.

articles.title: Menus and categories
articles.summary: A menu has categories. Categories have dishes.
articles.body:
Your menu has three levels:

- **Menus**, for example "All day" or "Drinks".
- **Categories** inside a menu, for example "Coffee" or "Breakfast".
- **Dishes** inside a category.

**Add a menu**

1. Open **Menu editor**.
2. Tap **New menu**. Type a name. Tap **Save**.

**Add a category**

1. Open the menu.
2. Tap **Add category**. Type a name, for example "Coffee". Tap **Save**.

**Change the order.** Drag a category or a dish by its handle. Guests see the new order at once.

**Show a menu only at some times.** Open the menu, tap **Edit menu**, then **When it is shown → At set times**. Add a time window, for example Monday 07:00 to 11:00. Times are in your restaurant's time zone.

![The menu editor](/help/shots/menu-editor-phone.webp "phone") ![The menu editor](/help/shots/menu-editor-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: Add a dish
articles.summary: Name, price, photo and description, step by step.
articles.body:
1. Open **Menu editor** (in the app: **Menu**) and the category.
2. Tap **Add item**.
3. Type the **Name**, for example "Macchiato".
4. Type the **Price**, for example 120 or 120.50.
5. Add a **Short line**. Guests see it under the name.
6. Add a **Photo** (see [Dish photos](help:dish-photos)).
7. Tap **Save**.

![The dish editor](/help/shots/dish-editor-phone.webp "phone") ![The dish editor](/help/shots/dish-editor-desktop.webp "desktop")

More tabs in the dish editor:

- **Prices & sizes**: for example Small and Large, each with its own price.
- **Add-ons**: choices like extra cheese. Guests see them as information.
- **Tags & allergens**: Vegan, Spicy, Halal, and allergens like milk or gluten.
- **New** and **Popular** badges. "New" can end by itself on a date.

**In the app:** tap **Add dish with photo** on Home. Take the photo, type the name and price, and tap **Save**.

articles.title: Dish photos
articles.summary: Up to 5 photos for each dish. How to take good ones.
articles.body:
Each dish can have up to **5 photos**. The first one is the main photo. Guests swipe to see the others.

1. Open the dish.
2. Tap **Add photo**. On a phone you can tap **Take photo**.
3. Drag the photo to move it. Use the slider to zoom.
4. Tap **Use photo**.

To change the main photo, tap **Main** on another photo.

**Good photos**

- Use daylight from a window. Don't use the flash.
- Take the photo from above or from the side of the plate.
- Fill the picture with the food.
- A file can be up to 8 MB. JPEG, PNG and WebP work.

**iPhone:** HEIC photos can't be used. On the iPhone open **Settings → Camera → Formats** and choose **Most Compatible**.

Your plan allows 100 photos in total on the Free plan. See [plans](help:plans-compared).

articles.title: Change prices
articles.summary: One price, many prices at once, or prices for one branch.
articles.body:
**One dish**

1. Open the dish.
2. Change the **Price**. Tap **Save**.

In the app you can also tap **Change a price** on Home.

**Many dishes at once**

1. Open **All dishes**.
2. Tick the dishes. You can also search or filter first.
3. Tap **Change price**.
4. Type a percent, for example 10. For lower prices use a minus: -5.
5. Choose **Round to**, for example to whole numbers.
6. Tap **Apply**.

Sizes change too.

![All dishes with selected dishes](/help/shots/dishes-phone.webp "phone") ![All dishes with selected dishes](/help/shots/dishes-desktop.webp "desktop")

**Staff** can change prices only when the owner allowed it (**Team → Can edit prices**).

**A different price at one branch?** See [Branch prices](help:branch-prices).
**Prices that change by themselves**, for example a happy hour? See [Happy hour](help:happy-hour).

articles.title: Hide or show a dish
articles.summary: Take a dish off the menu without deleting it.
articles.body:
A hidden dish stays saved, with its photos and prices. Guests don't see it.

1. Open the dish.
2. Turn off **Visible to guests**. Tap **Save**.

To show it again, turn **Visible to guests** on.

**Many dishes:** open **All dishes**, tick them and tap **Hide** or **Show**.

**In the app:** tap **Hide or show a dish** on Home.

Only out of stock for today? Use [Sold out](help:sold-out) instead. Then guests still see the dish.

articles.title: Sold out
articles.summary: Show guests that a dish is finished for now.
articles.body:
A sold-out dish stays on the menu with the label **Sold out**. Guests know it exists, but can't have it now.

**Mark a dish sold out**

1. Open **Menu editor** or **All dishes** (in the app: **Menu**).
2. Turn on the **Sold out** switch next to the dish.

**In the app:** tap **Mark sold out** on Home and tap the dishes.

**When it is back:** on the dashboard, find **Sold out now** and tap **Available again**.

![The sold-out list in the app](/help/shots/app-sold-out.webp "app")

Staff can mark dishes sold out too.
Each branch can have its own sold-out dishes: see [Branch prices](help:branch-prices).

articles.title: Add-ons, tags and allergens
articles.summary: Extra choices, labels like Vegan, and allergens.
articles.body:
**Add-ons** are choices guests can add, like extra toppings or milk type. They are information only.

1. Open **Add-ons**. Tap **New add-on group**.
2. Type a name, for example "Extra toppings".
3. Add options, each with an **Extra price** if needed.
4. Choose **At least** and **At most**, for example "choose up to 2".
5. Tap **Save**. Then open a dish, tab **Add-ons**, and tick the group.

**Tags** are labels on a dish. Built-in tags (Vegan, Spicy, Halal, Gluten-free, New, Popular) are translated by themselves. Add your own on **Tags**, for example "Chef's pick".

**Allergens:** open a dish, tab **Tags & allergens**, and tick them. Guests see them in the dish details.

articles.title: All dishes in one list
articles.summary: Find, check and change many dishes at once.
articles.body:
**All dishes** shows every dish of every menu in one list.

- **Search** by name.
- **Filter** by menu, category or status: On the menu, Hidden, No photo, Sold out.
- **Sort** by name, price or last change.

Tick dishes to change many at once: **Hide**, **Show**, **Change price**, **Delete**, **Sold out**, **Available**.

Deleting removes the dishes and their photos from every menu. It can't be undone.

articles.title: Import and export with a spreadsheet
articles.summary: Add or change many dishes with Excel or CSV.
articles.body:
**Export** downloads every menu, category and dish in one file.

1. Open **Import & export**.
2. Under **Export**, tap **Excel** or **CSV**.

**Import** adds or changes many dishes at once. You see a preview before anything is saved.

1. Download the **Empty template** or an export.
2. Fill it in. One row is one dish.
3. Tap **Choose file**. The file can be up to 5 MB.
4. Check the **Preview**: New, Changed, Unchanged and Errors.
5. Fix rows with errors in the file and upload it again.
6. Tap **Import**.

How the file works:

- Dishes are matched by menu, category and dish name.
- An empty cell keeps the current value.
- Sizes: `Small=60; Large=80`. Prices: `120` or `120.50`.
- Tags and allergens: separated by commas.

![The import preview](/help/shots/import-phone.webp "phone") ![The import preview](/help/shots/import-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: Menu styles A, B, C and D
articles.summary: Choose how your menu looks to guests.
articles.body:
Open **Appearance → Menu style**. The preview shows the change at once. Guests see it after you tap **Save**.

- **A · Warm editorial**: big photos first and serif headings, like a printed café menu.
- **B · Fresh grid**: your name on the banner and two photo cards per row, like a food app.
- **C · Quiet bistro**: a calm list with small photos on the right. Quickest to scan.
- **D · Minimal**: text only. Names, short descriptions and prices. No dish photos. Fastest.

A style with a lock is not in your plan. See [plans](help:plans-compared).

![Appearance with the preview](/help/shots/appearance-phone.webp "phone") ![Appearance with the preview](/help/shots/appearance-desktop.webp "desktop")

**Themes** are ready-made looks. Pick one, then change the colour or font.

articles.title: Logo and banner
articles.summary: Add your logo and the wide photo at the top.
articles.body:
1. Open **Appearance → Logo and banner**.
2. Tap **Logo** and choose your logo. A square picture works best.
3. Tap **Banner** and choose a wide photo. The page shows the best size.
4. Under **Logo and name**, choose **On the banner** or **Below the banner**.
5. Tap **Save**.

The banner is cropped to the shape of your menu style. It is also the picture people see when you share your menu link (see [Social preview](help:social-preview)).

To hide them, turn off **Show the logo** or **Show the banner**.

articles.title: Colours and fonts
articles.summary: Your brand colour and the font of your menu.
articles.body:
1. Open **Appearance**.
2. Tap **Brand colour** and pick your colour.
3. Choose a **Font**: Style default, Classic serif or Rounded.
4. Tap **Save**.

If your colour is hard to read on white, guests see a darker shade of it. Then the text stays readable.

Guests whose phone is in dark mode see a dark menu by themselves.

articles.title: A menu without photos
articles.summary: A fast text menu, or hide photos for a while.
articles.body:
Two ways:

1. Choose style **D · Minimal**. It shows names, short lines and prices, with no dish photos. It opens fastest, also on slow internet.
2. In any style, turn off **Show photos** in **Appearance**. Your photos stay saved. Turn it on again to show them.

You can also hide the photos of one dish: open the dish and turn off **Show photo on menu**.

articles.title: What guests see on the menu
articles.summary: Show or hide prices, descriptions, calories and buttons.
articles.body:
In **Appearance** you can turn these on or off:

- **Show prices**
- **Show photos**
- **Show descriptions**
- **Show calories**
- **Show "Share menu" button**
- **Show "Download menu (PDF)" link**
- **Show "My order" list** (see [My order](help:my-order))

Tap **Save**. Guests see it at once.

Opening hours, address and Wi-Fi come from **Restaurant info**. Leave a field empty to hide it.

articles.title: Opening hours, address and Wi-Fi
articles.summary: What guests see under "Info & opening hours".
articles.body:
Open **Restaurant info**.

**About and contact:** a short description, address, map link, phone, e-mail, social media and website. Leave a field empty to hide it.

**Wi-Fi:** type the network name and password. Turn on **Show Wi-Fi on the menu**.

**Opening hours**

1. For each day, tap **Add hours** and set the times.
2. Closed for lunch? Tap **Add time after a break**.
3. Same hours every weekday? Tap **Copy to Tuesday–Friday**.
4. Tap **Save hours**.

A closing time earlier than the opening time runs past midnight.

**Holidays:** under **Holidays and closed days**, add the dates and a note. Guests see "Closed today" and a notice before.

articles.title: Add a branch
articles.summary: Each branch has its own address, tables and QR codes.
articles.body:
1. Open **Branches**. Tap **New branch**.
2. Type the **Name**, for example "Bole".
3. Check the **Web address**. It is part of the branch menu address.
4. Add the address, phone and map link.
5. Choose the **Menus shown at this branch**.
6. Tap **Save**.

The main branch opens at your restaurant's own address. To change it, open a branch and tap **Make this the main branch**.

Your plan allows 1 branches on the Free plan. See [plans](help:plans-compared).

![Branches](/help/shots/branches-phone.webp "phone") ![Branches](/help/shots/branches-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: Branch prices and availability
articles.summary: A different price, or a hidden dish, at one branch.
articles.body:
1. Open **Branches**.
2. Tap **Prices & availability** on the branch.
3. Type a new price next to a dish. Leave it blank to use the main menu price.
4. Under availability choose **As main menu**, **Sold out**, or **Hide**.
5. Tap **Save**. Guests at this branch see it at once.

articles.title: Tables and branch QR codes
articles.summary: A QR code for each table.
articles.body:
Every table gets its own QR code. Then you can see which tables scan most in Insights.

1. Open **Branches**. Tap **Tables** on the branch.
2. Under **Add numbered tables**, type a name (for example "Table") and From 1 To 12. Tap **Add tables**.
3. Or add one table, for example "Terrace 2".
4. Tap **Print table cards**. You get four cards per A4 page, with cut lines.

Deleting a table makes its printed QR code stop working.

articles.title: Your menu link
articles.summary: Share your menu on WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram.
articles.body:
Your menu is at **http://127.0.0.1:8000/demo**.

- On the dashboard, tap **View menu** to open it.
- In the app, tap **Share menu link / QR** on Home. Choose WhatsApp, Telegram or any app.
- Put the link in your Instagram bio and your Google Maps listing.

![Your menu as guests see it](/help/shots/guest-menu-phone.webp "phone") ![Your menu as guests see it](/help/shots/guest-menu-desktop.webp "desktop")

Guests can share it too, with the **Share menu** button on the menu.

articles.title: QR codes
articles.summary: Download, print and test your QR codes.
articles.body:
Open **QR codes**. You see a code for your restaurant, each branch and each table.

1. Under **Download**, tap **PDF**, **PNG** or **SVG** next to a code.
2. Print it at 100 % size, at least 3 cm wide.
3. **Scan one test copy** with your phone before you print many.

**Extra codes** are for a flyer, a poster or the window. They are counted on their own in Insights.

1. Under **Extra code**, type a name, for example "Window poster".
2. Choose what it **Opens**. Tap **Add code**.

A printed code keeps working, even if you change your menu address. Deleting a code makes its copies stop working.

![QR codes](/help/shots/qr-codes-phone.webp "phone") ![QR codes](/help/shots/qr-codes-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: Print materials
articles.summary: Table tents, posters, stickers and a window sign with your QR code.
articles.body:
1. Open **QR codes → Print materials**.
2. Choose **What to print**: Table tent, Poster A5, Poster A4, Window sign, Round or Square stickers.
3. Choose a **Design** (Classic, Bold, Minimal) and **Colours** (Light or Dark).
4. Type a **Headline** if you like (up to 40 letters).
5. Choose **Which QR codes**. You get one page, tent or sticker for each code.
6. Tap **Download PDF**.

Going to a print shop? Turn on **For a print shop (3 mm bleed)**.

**For social media:** download a **Square post** or a **Story** picture with your code.

![Print materials](/help/shots/print-materials-phone.webp "phone") ![Print materials](/help/shots/print-materials-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: PDF menu
articles.summary: A printable A4 menu from your online menu.
articles.body:
1. Open **Menu editor**.
2. Tap **Download PDF menu**.
3. Choose the **Menu** (or All menus), the **Branch**, **With photos** or not, and the **Layout** (1 or 2 columns).
4. Tap **Download PDF**.

The PDF uses your colour and style. Hidden and sold-out dishes are left out.

Guests can download it too, when **Show "Download menu (PDF)" link** is on in **Appearance**.

articles.title: The picture when you share a link
articles.summary: What WhatsApp, Telegram and Facebook show for your link.
articles.body:
When you share your menu link, apps show a small card: a picture, your name and a short text.

- **The picture** is your banner. No banner? Then a default picture is used.
- **The name** is your restaurant name (and the branch).
- **The text** is the short description from **Restaurant info**.

Changed your banner, but WhatsApp still shows the old picture? Apps keep their own copy for a while. Share the link again later, or in a new chat.

articles.title: Promotions
articles.summary: Specials and announcements at the top of your menu.
articles.body:
A promotion is shown at the top of your menu. It can start and end by itself.

1. Open **Promotions**. Tap **New promotion**.
2. Choose the **Type**: **Special** (a dish) or **Announcement** (news, for example "Live music on Friday").
3. Type the **Title** and the **Text**. Add a **Photo** if you like.
4. For a special, choose the **Linked dish**. Guests can tap it to see the dish.
5. Set **Starts** and **Ends**. Leave Ends empty for no end.
6. Choose the **Branch**, or All branches.
7. Tap **Save**.

Use the arrows to change the order. Turn off **Show on the menu** to pause a promotion.

![Promotions](/help/shots/promotions-phone.webp "phone") ![Promotions](/help/shots/promotions-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: Happy hour and lunch prices
articles.summary: Special prices that switch on and off by themselves.
articles.body:
A **price period** changes prices at set times, for example every day from 17:00 to 19:00. Guests see the normal price crossed out and the special price.

1. Open **Promotions → Price periods**. Tap **New price period**.
2. Type the **Name shown to guests**, for example "Happy hour".
3. Choose the **Days** and the times **From** and **Until**.
4. Tap **Add a dish**. For each dish choose **% off** or **New price**.
5. Turn on **Use this price period**. Tap **Save**.

**What guests see now** shows if a period is running. The menu changes by itself when a period starts or ends. Times are in your restaurant's time zone. An end time earlier than the start runs past midnight.

![A price period](/help/shots/happy-hour-phone.webp "phone") ![A price period](/help/shots/happy-hour-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: "My order": the list guests show the waiter
articles.summary: Guests note dishes on their phone, then show the list.
articles.body:
With **My order**, guests tap **Add to my order** on dishes. They see the total at the bottom. Then they show the list to the waiter.

It is **not** an online order. Nothing is sent to you. The list says: "This is not an order. Show it to your waiter."

![My order on a guest's phone](/help/shots/guest-my-order-phone.webp "phone") ![My order on a guest's phone](/help/shots/guest-my-order-desktop.webp "desktop")

**Turn it on or off:** open **Appearance** and use **Show "My order" list**.

**Numbers:** the dashboard and Insights show how many lists guests made, the average value, and the most added dishes. They are counted without names. In the app, open the **Orders** tab.

articles.title: Insights explained
articles.summary: Views, scans, top dishes and QR codes, and the monthly report.
articles.body:
Open **Insights**. Choose the **Period** (last 7, 30 or 90 days) and the **Branch**.

- **Menu views**: how many times your menu page was opened.
- **QR scans**: views that came from a QR code.
- **Dish details opened**: how often guests opened a dish.
- **Most viewed dishes**: your most popular dishes.
- **Scans per QR code**: which tables and posters bring guests in.

Search engines, link previews and speed tests are not counted. We count without cookies and without storing anyone's address.

![Insights](/help/shots/insights-phone.webp "phone") ![Insights](/help/shots/insights-desktop.webp "desktop")

**Export:** tap **Export** for a PDF report or CSV files.

**Monthly report:** turn on **E-mail me the monthly report**. Owners get last month's report as a PDF on the 1st.

articles.title: Add your team
articles.summary: Invite staff and managers, and choose what they may do.
articles.body:
1. Open **Team**. Tap **Invite**.
2. Type their e-mail and choose a **Role**.
3. Tap **Send invitation**. The link works for 7 days.

They open the e-mail, make a password and sign in.

![The team page](/help/shots/team-phone.webp "phone") ![The team page](/help/shots/team-desktop.webp "desktop")

**Pending invitations** shows who has not joined yet. Tap the cross to cancel one.

**Remove someone:** tap **Remove from team**. They lose access at once.

articles.title: Roles and permissions
articles.summary: What owners, managers and staff can do.
articles.body:
| | Owner | Manager | Staff |
|---|---|---|---|
| Menu, dishes, photos | ✓ | ✓ | |
| Prices | ✓ | ✓ | only if allowed |
| Sold out | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Appearance, QR codes, branches | ✓ | ✓ | |
| Invite people | ✓ | staff only | |
| Billing and plan | ✓ | | |

- **Owners** do everything, also billing.
- **Managers** edit the menu, branches and settings, and can invite staff.
- **Staff** see the menu and mark dishes sold out. Turn on **Can edit prices** to let them change prices.

To change a role, open **Team** and choose a new role next to the name.

articles.title: Change your password or e-mail
articles.summary: Keep your account safe.
articles.body:
**Password**

1. Open **Settings → Security**.
2. Type your **Current password** and a new one (at least 10 characters).
3. Tap **Save password**.

Forgot it? On the sign-in page tap **Forgot password?**. We send you a link.

**E-mail:** open **Settings → Profile**, type the new address and your password. We send a link to the new address. Your address changes when you tap it (within 1 hour).

Changing your password in the app signs out your other phones.

articles.title: Two-factor sign-in (2FA)
articles.summary: A code from your phone, so a stolen password is not enough.
articles.body:
After your password, you also type a 6-digit code from an app on your phone.

1. Install an authenticator app, for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
2. Open **Settings → Security → Two-factor sign-in**. Tap **Turn on**.
3. Type your password.
4. Scan the QR code with the authenticator app.
5. Type the 6-digit code it shows. Tap **Verify**.
6. **Save the recovery codes** somewhere safe, for example on paper. Each one lets you sign in once if you lose your phone.

![Security settings](/help/shots/security-phone.webp "phone") ![Security settings](/help/shots/security-desktop.webp "desktop")

Lost your phone and your codes? Contact support:

Ask the person who set up your account.

articles.title: Sign out other browsers and phones
articles.summary: Signed in on a shared or lost device? End it here.
articles.body:
**Other browsers:** open **Settings → Security → Other browsers**. Tap **Sign out of all other browsers**. This browser stays signed in.

**Phones with the app:** in the app, open **More → Profile → Devices**. Tap **Sign out this device** next to the phone.

Changing your password also signs out your other phones.

articles.title: What each plan includes
articles.summary: Prices, limits and features of every plan.
articles.body:
These are today's plans:

- **Free** — Free, no end date. Unlimited dishes · 100 photos · 1 branch · unlimited team members · 2 menu styles. Includes: import and export, PDF menu, "My order".
- **Plus** — Br 490 a month. Unlimited dishes · 500 photos · 1 branch · unlimited team members · 4 menu styles. Adds: promotions, Insights.
- **Pro** — Br 990 a month. Unlimited dishes · 2,000 photos · 3 branches · unlimited team members · 4 menu styles. Adds: more branches, happy hour prices, menu without our name.
- **Business** — Br 2,490 a month. Unlimited dishes · unlimited photos · unlimited branches · unlimited team members · 4 menu styles.

New restaurants start on **Free**. Your data stays when you change plans.

To upgrade, see [Upgrade your plan](help:upgrade).

articles.title: Upgrade your plan
articles.summary: How to change plans and pay.
articles.body:
1. Choose a plan from [What each plan includes](help:plans-compared).
2. Contact us:

Ask the person who set up your account.

3. Pay by mobile money or bank transfer.
4. We record your payment. Your plan changes at once. You get an invoice.

Open **Settings → Billing** to see your plan, **Paid until** and your **Invoices** (PDF).

![Billing](/help/shots/billing-phone.webp "phone") ![Billing](/help/shots/billing-desktop.webp "desktop")

articles.title: When your plan ends
articles.summary: What happens after the paid-until date.
articles.body:
1. **Grace time:** for 7 days you can still edit everything. A banner asks you to renew.
2. **Read-only:** for 14 more days, guests still see your menu, but you can't change it.
3. **Offline:** then your menu goes offline until you renew.

Your data is not deleted. Renew any time: see [Upgrade your plan](help:upgrade).

articles.title: Install the Menu Admin app
articles.summary: Manage your menu from your phone.
articles.body:
The **Menu Admin** app does the daily jobs on your phone: prices, photos, sold out, sharing.

1. Open the **Google Play Store** (Android) or the **App Store** (iPhone).
2. Search for **Menu Admin**.
3. Tap **Install**.
4. Open the app and sign in with the same e-mail and password as the website.

![The app's sign-in screen](/help/shots/app-sign-in.webp "app")

The app asks to send notifications, for example when your monthly report is ready. You can change this later in **Settings**.

articles.title: The app's Home and quick actions
articles.summary: The buttons for the jobs you do every day.
articles.body:
**Home** shows today's views and scans and how many dishes are sold out. Under **Quick actions**:

- **Change a price**
- **Hide or show a dish**
- **Add dish with photo**
- **Share menu link / QR**
- **Mark sold out**
- **Promotions**

![The app's Home](/help/shots/app-home.webp "app")

At the bottom: **Home**, **Menu**, **Orders** and **More**. **More** has everything else: All dishes, branches, QR codes, appearance, team, billing and Help.

Pull down on a screen to load the newest data.

articles.title: Using the app offline
articles.summary: What works without internet.
articles.body:
The app saves what you saw last. Without internet you can still open your menu, your numbers and this Help.

A bar says **"You're offline. Showing saved data; changes need a connection."**

To change something (a price, a photo, sold out), you need a connection. When you are online again, pull down to refresh.

articles.title: "Update required" and other app messages
articles.summary: What to do when the app asks you to update.
articles.body:
- **"Update required"**: your app is too old. Tap **Update now**, or open the Play Store or App Store and update **Menu Admin**.
- **"A new version of the app is ready"**: an update is ready. Tap **Update now**, or close the line and update later.
- **"Down for maintenance"**: we are updating the system. Wait a few minutes and tap **Try again**.
- **"The app is not available"**: use the website for now. Tap **Open the website**.

You can always use the website at http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin.

articles.title: My QR code doesn't open
articles.summary: Check these five things.
articles.body:
1. **Print size:** the code must be at least 3 cm wide. Print at 100 %, not "fit to page".
2. **Paper:** shiny paper reflects light. Use matt paper.
3. **Deleted code:** if you deleted the code, the table or the branch, its copies stop working. Download the code again.
4. **Light:** scan in good light. Hold the phone 20–30 cm away.
5. **Plan ended:** if your menu is offline, the code opens a page that says so. See [When your plan ends](help:plan-ended).

Test one copy before you print many.

articles.title: My photos look blurry
articles.summary: How to get sharp dish photos.
articles.body:
- Use a photo of at least 1000 pixels wide. Photos from WhatsApp are often made small: send them as a **document**, or use the original from the camera.
- Clean the camera lens.
- Use daylight. Don't zoom in with the camera: move closer.
- Crop less. When you crop a small part, it gets blurry.

The menu makes small versions for fast loading. A sharp original stays sharp.

articles.title: A dish doesn't show on my menu
articles.summary: Check these things.
articles.body:
1. **Hidden?** Open the dish. Is **Visible to guests** on?
2. **Hidden category?** Open the category. Is it visible?
3. **Menu at set times?** A menu with **At set times** shows only in its time windows.
4. **Other branch?** Check **Branches → Prices & availability**. The dish may be hidden at that branch. Also check which menus the branch shows.
5. **Old page?** Pull down on the phone, or close and open the menu again.

articles.title: I can't sign in
articles.summary: Wrong password, no code, or a locked account.
articles.body:
- **Wrong password?** Tap **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page. We send a link to your e-mail. Look in spam too.
- **"Too many tries"?** Wait one minute and try again.
- **No 2FA code?** Use one of your recovery codes instead.
- **Lost your phone and codes?** Contact support (below).
- **E-mail not confirmed?** Open the link from our first e-mail, or tap **Resend email**.
- **"Your account is not part of any restaurant"?** Ask the owner to invite you again.

Ask the person who set up your account.

articles.title: The app doesn't work
articles.summary: Update, maintenance, or a sign-in problem.
articles.body:
1. **Update the app** in the Play Store or App Store.
2. **"Down for maintenance"?** Wait a few minutes and tap **Try again**.
3. **Signed out?** Sign in again. A phone not used for 60 days is signed out by itself.
4. **No internet?** See [Using the app offline](help:app-offline).
5. Still not working? Use the website at http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin and contact us.

articles.title: How to use Help
articles.summary: Search, the ? button, and asking us.
articles.body:
- **Search:** type a few words, for example "price" or "QR".
- **The ? button** at the top of every page opens the article for that page.
- **Was this helpful?** Tap Yes or No under an article. It tells us which articles to make better.
- In the app, Help works **without internet** too. It shows the articles you loaded last.

![Help on a phone and a computer](/help/shots/help-centre-phone.webp "phone") ![Help on a phone and a computer](/help/shots/help-centre-desktop.webp "desktop")

Still stuck? See [Contact support](help:contact-support).

articles.title: FAQ: the 20 most asked questions
articles.summary: Short answers to common questions.
articles.body:
**1. Is it really free?** Yes. The Free plan has no end date. Paid plans add more. See [plans](help:plans-compared).

**2. Do guests need an app?** No. They scan the QR code and the menu opens in their browser.

**3. Can guests order and pay online?** No. "My order" is a list they show the waiter. Nothing is sent or paid.

**4. Do I need to print new QR codes when I change the menu?** No. The code always opens your newest menu.

**5. Do I need new QR codes when I change my menu address?** No. Printed codes keep working.

**6. How many dishes can I add?** no limit on the Free plan.

**7. How many photos?** Up to 5 per dish. In total 100 on the Free plan.

**8. Can I hide a dish for a day?** Yes: [hide it](help:hide-a-dish) or mark it [sold out](help:sold-out).

**9. Can prices change by themselves?** Yes, with [happy hour prices](help:happy-hour).
**10. Can I have more than one branch?** Yes: see [Add a branch](help:branches).
**11. Can my staff help?** Yes. [Invite them](help:team) as Staff.

**12. Can I see how many people look at my menu?** The dashboard shows today. [Insights](help:insights) shows more.
**13. Does the menu work on slow internet?** Yes. It is small and fast. Style D is fastest.

**14. Can I print a paper menu?** Yes: [PDF menu](help:pdf-menu).
**15. Is my data safe?** Yes. We make backups every day. Turn on [two-factor sign-in](help:two-factor).

**16. Can I use my phone only?** Yes. The website works on phones, and there is [an app](help:install-app).

**17. How do I pay?** By mobile money or bank transfer. See [Upgrade your plan](help:upgrade).

**18. What happens when my plan ends?** See [When your plan ends](help:plan-ended).

**19. Can I change the currency?** Contact us. Prices are not converted.

**20. Can I delete my account?** Yes. Contact us. We delete your restaurant and data.

articles.title: Contact support
articles.summary: How to reach us.
articles.body:
We are happy to help.

Ask the person who set up your account.

Please tell us:

- your restaurant name or menu address,
- what you wanted to do,
- what happened (a screenshot helps).

Never send us your password.
